items.title: SpaceX Starship's Historic Orbital Achievement
points: Starship completed its 14th test flight, becoming the first time the massive rocket entered orbit and remained in space
The vehicle deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites successfully during the mission
Mission ended after approximately 90 minutes instead of the planned 10-hour flight, but this is a major success for NASA's lunar plans

NASA relies on Starship to land astronauts on the Moon for the Artemis program (a NASA initiative aiming to return humans to the Moon); a major failure would have jeopardized an already tight timeline

items.title: New Penguin Species Discovered
points: Researchers found the first new penguin species in over 100 years by discovering gentoo penguins actually comprise four distinct species
Three of the four species face habitat loss from climate change

items.title: Medieval Potion Offers New Antibiotic Strategy
points: Scientists recreated Bald's eyesalve, a 10th-century remedy made from garlic, onion, bovine bile, and wine
Testing found the compound damages bacterial membranes, blocks cell-to-cell communication, and weakens biofilms (protective structures bacteria form to resist treatment)
Bacteria took significantly longer to develop resistance to the medieval remedy compared to modern antibiotics
Researchers plan to develop a lab-made version of the key ingredients rather than suggesting home brewing

items.title: Humidity-Powered Wallpaper Could Run Smart Home Devices
points: Scientists developed paper-based wallpaper packed with tiny moisture-electric generators (devices that extract water vapor from the air and convert it into electrical voltage)
A full-scale sheet containing 1,596 units produced enough power to run a wireless keyboard while simultaneously lowering room humidity
The system cannot yet power large appliances but could potentially keep battery-free sensors, thermostats, and other small smart-home devices running indefinitely
The technology represents a step toward harvesting ambient energy from everyday environments

issues.subject: 🚀 SpaceX just cleared a massive hurdle

headlines: SpaceX's Starship completed its 14th test flight and entered orbit for the first time, deploying 26 Starlink satellites and clearing a major hurdle for NASA's Artemis Moon landing program.
Researchers identified the first new penguin species in over 100 years by discovering that gentoo penguins actually comprise four distinct species, though three face habitat loss from climate change.
Scientists recreated a 10th-century medieval remedy called Bald's eyesalve and found it damages bacterial membranes and delays resistance development, potentially inspiring new antibiotic treatments.
A paper-based wallpaper embedded with moisture-electric generators can pull water vapor from indoor air and convert it into steady voltage, with a full-scale sheet powering wireless devices.
